Players Committee gallery image of [[Captain Needa (PC Errata)|Captain Needa]], present in the capture of 16 December 2007 at 20:03:22 UTC. The lower-right mark is a bronze round disc, without an E or number. The full image includes its published black matte and drop shadow.

Source: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071216200322id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/cards/dagobah/ds/captainneeda.gif PC gallery capture]. The capture establishes that the image was available by that time; it does not establish its first publication day. Exact recovered GIF: 65,576 bytes, 367 × 506 pixels, SHA-256 <code style="overflow-wrap:anywhere; word-break:break-all;">1b58ef3ac4dd608017b307e663e3f6b5209b03c10db02cded410d449df842abf</code>. The bytes match the previously retained CDX digest, SHA-1 <code>3409fc9d8d4588db87b357618761916b092a55e5</code>.
